reasons.P-domain: session-free; its symbols resolve to the destination crate, which reaches every referenced crate
reasons.P-lowest-covering: session-free; the primary owner does not reach the crates in blockers, the destination is the lowest crate that reaches them all
reasons.P-library: session-free; no wow-world-* symbol: tests library code through wow-world (stays until a library destination is chosen)
reasons.P-world-items: session-free but uses the wow-world-owned production items in blockers (stays)
reasons.P-unreached: session-free but no wow-world-* crate reaches every referenced crate (stays)
reasons.H-host: builds a session, but every session call is a host-trait method of, or a one-statement forward into, the destination; movable only with a destination test host (T2 go/no-go)
reasons.W-world-logic: calls the WorldSession methods in blockers, which hold World logic or World-owned forwards
reasons.W-multi-domain: its session calls route to the several domains in blockers
reasons.W-core-only: its session calls route only to wow-world-core, the hub that stays with composition
reasons.W-world-items: its session calls are domain forwards, but it uses the wow-world-owned items in blockers
reasons.W-unreached: its session calls route to one domain that does not reach the crates in blockers
reasons.W-fields: builds a WorldSession and only reads or writes its fields
